vb_textbox.text: Pick a colour from the each pair of gnomes (e.g. red, green, brown, purple), and see how many mushrooms you get. If it is a high number (3 or above in my opinion) stick with it each time. If it is 2 or less, choose the other gnome in the pair next time. If the mushrooms the gnome gives you each time drops to 2 or less, switch to the other and do this back and forth until the number is 3 or higher and stick again.Essentially, pay close attention and keep choosing the same gnome each time as long as the mushroom count they give is high. If it goes too low, switch.
